title: Video Edit: a picture of another shape is squeezed into the clip's frame (into the picture's room)
description: Swap the person into the PICTURE's room (template 6) hands H3 the picture aspect-kept, and H3 rebuilds the picture's whole room inside the clip's canvas, squeezing it: imported_006 (1232x2016, 0.611) into a 576x1024 render came out ~8% narrower, measured on frame 0 against the picture scaled to 576x1024. Crop the picture to the render's shape before H3 on that route. Also seen: two runs fed an H3 result as the clip trail the dance by ~0.6 s (motion lag measured), not yet explained.
